name: Init order
info:
Startup

1. CONSTANTS
2. CONFIG
3. PREFS
4. HOST
5. UTILS
6. DEVICES
7. STATE
8. Validate Startup
9. Startup Complete

CONSTANTS has no dependencies.
CONFIG may use constants.
PREFS may depend on configuration (default values, storage location, etc.).
HOST is independent and can be collected early.
UTILS may use constants/config.
DEVICES will almost certainly use CONSTANTS, CONFIG, and possibly PREFS.
STATE is last because it represents the initial runtime state after everything else exists.
